module: Flowgraph node "Stop Cam Path" (once_instant). Stops a camera path: the active path is not considered completed but becomes inactive. Optional (hidden) input id: without id, tries to use the active path.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawMiddle.desc: Central area of the node (nothing displayed).
